source: Official public list prices (USD per 1M tokens), standard tier, captured 2026-10-26; per-model URLs in sources
notes: Anthropic: cache_write is the 5-minute cache write price (1-hour writes cost more: Sonnet 5.5 4.00, Opus 5.5 8.00); cache_read is 'cache hits and refreshes' (0.05x base input); 1M context is billed at standard rates; global routing (no 1.1x US-only multiplier), no fast mode, no batch. OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing redirects (301) to the developers.openai.com URL used; prices are the Standard tier, short context (<=272K input tokens); long context (>272K) is input/output/cached luna 0.20/0.75/0.02 and sol 4.00/15.00/0.40; cache_write is the short-context 30-minute write price (12-hour write: luna 0.25, sol 5.00). The harness records 0 cache-write tokens for Codex, so the OpenAI cache_write price does not change computed cost. All values are list prices, not billed amounts.
